services.name: Kayak Rental
services.desc: Kayak with the otters, sea lions and seals on the Monterey Bay About Discover otters, sea lions and seals on the Monterey Bay with a sea kayak! Paddle through the kelp forest canopy along Cannery Row and experience the Monterey Bay National Marine Sanctuary. You may be greeted by harbor seals swimming alongside you or resting sleepily on the rocks along the shore. Or you may witness a raft of otters rolling and playing in the kelp! Kayakers get an up close look at this wonder of nature teeming with marine Ages 5+

services.name: Traditional Bicycle Rental
services.desc: With miles of dedicated bike paths and bike lanes along the Monterey Bay, biking is a must-do while you are here. We will provide you with a 7-speed Traditional Bike, bike map, helmet, and a bike The best way to explore the coastal bike trail and 17-mile Drive in Pebble Beach

services.name: Surrey Rental
services.desc: Delight the kids with a family excursion along Monterey’s Recreation Trail with our four-wheel bikes called surreys. These pedal-driven carriages are a great way for a couple, family or group of friends to enjoy a leisureSly ride together to explore Fisherman’s Wharf, the surrounding area, museums, specialty shops, Cannery Row and the beautiful coastal area, while providing highly interactive and healthy Great family fun!

services.name: Electric Bike Rental
services.desc: Now offering electric bicycles! Come try out our new electric bikes! These electric bikes have a combination pedal assist and throttle giving the rider the choice of pedaling along with the motor or just being along for the ride. Give it a whirl! Minimum age for E-bike riders is 13 years of Explore Monterey and 17-mile drive with a "boost"

services.name: Paddle Board Rental
services.desc: Today’s latest surf craze is stand up paddleboards! Do you want to try Standup Paddleboarding? Get out on the water and have some fun! Experience gliding on the water’s surface using a large long board built for stability. You propel yourself with what is essentially a long canoe paddle and you are off – this is as close as it gets to “walking on water”. If you’ve ever wanted to try your hand at this up and coming sport, we have you covered! Whether you want a rental or a lesson, we have the equipment and instructors to get you out on the water. No matter if you are young or old, Experience the beauty of Monterey Bay!

services.desc: Family-friendly kayaking tour in the Monterey Bay National Marine Sanctuary to view sea otters, harbor seals, and sea lions in their natural habitat. Our most popular group tour leaving daily at 8AM 10AM 2PM and 4PM

services.name: Private Cannery Row Kayak Tour
services.desc: Tours start in the heart of the Cannery Row kelp forest and visit the resident raft of otters right in front of the shop! This location is located a short paddle from both the Aquarium and the Coast Guard pier – both areas are prime for wildlife viewing. We can almost guarantee you will see otters, harbor seals and sea lions. We Provide: A professional guide A dry bag for a phone or camera to take pictures Paddling and wildlife orientation. Please bring a towel, hat or sunglasses and sunscreen Please wear clothes that you don't mind getting wet as we have reduced our touch-points for You choose the start time for this private guided activity!

blurb: Adventures by the Sea provides visitors and locals the opportunity to discover Monterey by land and sea through rentals and tours of bikes, electric bikes, kayaks, surreys, and stand-up paddle boards. They have five locations throughout the Monterey Peninsula, including near Fisherman's Wharf and Cannery Row. Activities include spotting otters, biking the 17-Mile Drive, and family-friendly adventures.

quotes.author: Lucy
quotes.text: My two sons rented kayaks and has a fantastic time exploring the ocean! They saw loads of sealife including sealions and sea otters - and lots of big birds apparently! The staff were really friendly and chatty and helped them sort out everything they needed. A great experience.

quotes.author: Vicky
quotes.text: My husband and I and our 3 boys biked with Anne and then kayaked in the kelp beds with Jan the next day. Both experiences were fantastic. We especially loved the kayaking. The staff at Adventures by Sea is kind and patient and great with kids.

quotes.author: Corey
quotes.text: We had a blast! A few of us had ever kayaked before and they were helpful and made us excited. The best part is that there’s no time limit for the price so we spent lots of time seeing otters and seeks in person.
